title: Topological Signatures of Diffusive Release in Porous Media
summary: We used persistent homology to quantify the multiscale topological and geometric organization of porous media, including solid connectivity and the formation of loop-like and cavity-like structures across spatial scales. Through statistical analysis, we show that these topological and geometric features are closely associated with diffusion-driven release behavior in porous media.
